name: storybloq
description: Project memory for Claude Code and Codex. Storybloq stores tickets, issues, handovers, and lessons in a .story/ folder inside your repo.

sidebar.title: Ledger dashboard
sidebar.description: Draw the .story/ ledger in a pane beside the transcript. On by default; turn it off with /plugin configure storybloq. Projects with no .story/ directory show nothing either way (T-508, T-516).

startupLogo.title: Storyfield startup logo
startupLogo.description: Show a brief copper dot-wave logo before the dashboard. Turn off to show the board immediately.

motion.title: Dashboard motion
motion.description: Animate startup, phase progress, story updates, activity, and the context meter. Turn off for a static dashboard that still shows current status and activity.

changeHighlights.title: Story status highlights
changeHighlights.description: Briefly highlight changed stories and destination counts, and show Ready when a blocker clears. Requires Dashboard motion.

metadata.functionHooks: Early-access Claude Code API (client 2.1.273, see hooks/client-api.ts). By owner decision the ledger dashboard ships on by default in 1.15 (T-516): storybloq setup writes env.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 into ~/.claude/settings.json, which is what lets the client load this module at all, and the userConfig default above is what turns the Mod on inside it.
